19:77.text: Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our Ayât
(this Qur’ân and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
and said: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children

19:78.text: Has he known the Unseen or has he taken a covenant from the Most Gracious

19:79.text: Nay, We shall record what he says, and We shall increase his torment

19:80.text: And We shall inherit from him
(i.e. wealth and children which We have bestowed upon him in this world)
, and he shall come to Us alone.

19:81.text: besides Allâh, that they might give them honour, power and glory
(and also protect them from Allâh’s punishment)

19:82.text: will deny their worship of them, and become opponents to them

19:83.text: See you not that We have sent the Shayâtîn
against the disbelievers to push them to do evil.

19:84.text: So make no haste against them; We only count out to them a
(of the days of the life of this world and delay their term so that they may increase in evil and sins)

19:85.text: The Day We shall gather the Muttaqûn

19:86.text: And We shall drive the Mujrimûn
(polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh)
to Hell, in a thirsty state
(like a thirsty herd driven down to water)

19:87.text: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission

19:88.text: [as the Jews say: ‘Uzair (Ezra) is the son of Allâh, and the Christians say that He has begotten a son [‘Îsâ (Jesus) عليه السلام], and the pagan Arabs say that He has begotten daughters (angels and others.)]

19:90.text: Whereby the heavens are almost torn, and the earth is split asunder, and the mountains fall in ruins,

19:92.text: But it is not suitable for
that He should beget a son

19:93.text: There is none in the heavens and the earth but comes unto the Most Gracious

19:94.text: Verily He knows each one of them, and has counted them a full counting.

19:95.text: And everyone of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection
(without any helper, or protector or defender)
